weaknesses.title: Limit var names FLOOR and CAP hard-fail MAXF/MINF
weaknesses.detail: DEFAULT FLOOR=0 then MAXF obj field FLOOR → err 'MAXF object field limit' (halted). CAP same for MINF. Collision with FLOORF/CAPF form tokens. Must use FLIM/CLIM/PADW-style non-reserved names.
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT FLOOR=0; MAXF c energy FLOOR → MAXF object field limit

weaknesses.title: MAXF=floor MINF=cap naming inversion
weaknesses.detail: MAXF does max(field,lim)=floor; MINF does min(field,lim)=cap. Agents reading name alone invert remaining vs burst math. Aliases FLOORF/CAPF/ATLEASTF/ATMOSTF clearer but primary tokens mislead.

weaknesses.title: Bare unknown-object MAXF not always hard-exit
weaknesses.detail: TRY* documented soft; bare MAXF nosuch may halt mid-run with empty last_err in -q (exit_code 0 halted false) vs agent EXIT paths. Soft policy inconsistent with DIVF bare hard-fail.
weaknesses.repro: MAXF nosuch n 0 under HOLD_FLASH only

weaknesses.title: Single ARG2 NUM cannot multi-seed rem+burst+score
weaknesses.detail: Capturing ARG2 into REM and BURST and SCORE poisons open (all=100). Must action-scope A2_N or use CUBALC_FS_BURST/SCORE ENV only.
weaknesses.repro: open ARG2=100 without ENV → burst/score polluted if multi-assign

weaknesses.title: WRITE VAL omit trailing NL
weaknesses.detail: od -c META ends without \n after last field (dump\nq0).

weaknesses.title: REQUIRE=abc softens
weaknesses.detail: Non-numeric REQUIRE miss exit 0 even on gate deny.

weaknesses.title: BOUNDF CHANGED shared with one-sided flags
weaknesses.detail: Agents must read BOUNDF_CHANGED vs MINF_CHANGED/MAXF_CHANGED carefully after mixed floor/cap/bound sequences; LAST_N alone is final value not which op.
